description: The file is a test script written in Perl that performs unit testing for the FastCGI module of the lighttpd web server. It executes a series of HTTP requests against the server, verifies responses, and manages starting/stopping the server process during tests.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A Perl class used in testing the lighttpd server, providing methods to start, stop, and communicate with the server during tests.
